That’s fine, but I personally don’t like JSC because I think it trivializes the Passion of Christ in an almost obnoxious way.

Also, there’s the controversy of how it displays Judas Iscariot as a tragic hero of sorts, but that’s not what brings it down for me.

Ah-ha, your profile indicates you’re here to troll me. 

I’m not talking about any kind of anti-Semitic film. I’m talking about an event that occurs around this time of year that honors the death and resurrection of Jesus Christ. It’s an international event.

God bless you, and be your on your merry way.

There are intentional rules on this subreddit against this kind of trolling, so if you want to complain about the harassment scandal, go ahead and do so on 4chan or 9gag. I’m sure your two cents will be appreciated there.

Like I said, God bless you, have a good day, and have a most happy Easter.

That’s fine, I’m not condemning anyone who watches JSC.

Though the televised broadcast from last year was quite impressive—the only time I’ve ever seen it though.

I personally like “Judas’ Death”—I’m into the metal aspect of that song. 

I think it greatly depicts the breakdown of a man who dared turn in Jesus, a friend of Judas and the Savior of Man, for thirty measly pieces of silver.

You too, have a wonderful Good Friday and an amazing Easter!
